stories.name: Apple CEO transition
stories.blurb: John Ternus is succeeding Tim Cook as Apple CEO, raising questions about the company's future direction and leadership style.

stories.name: Apple Stock Q3 Rally
stories.blurb: Coverage debates whether Apple's stock rally ahead of and following its Q3 earnings report is justified, with analysts split on valuation, iPhone/services strength, and future price targets.

stories.name: Vanguard Growth ETF Debate
stories.blurb: A recurring theme of financial articles comparing and recommending Vanguard growth-focused ETFs (like VUG and VGT) against rivals as long-term investment options.

stories.name: Foldable iPhone Launch
stories.blurb: Apple, under new CEO John Ternus, unveiled its first foldable device, the iPhone Duo, at a September 9 event marking a major shift in the company's product lineup and leadership.

stories.name: Apple OpenAI trade secrets lawsuit
stories.blurb: Apple is suing OpenAI and former employees for allegedly stealing hardware trade secrets, and OpenAI is seeking to dismiss the case.

stories.name: Iran-Israel Oil Market Swings
stories.blurb: Stock markets fluctuate as investors react to escalating and de-escalating US-Iran/Middle East tensions, oil price swings, and their effects on earnings, Fed policy, and economic data.

stories.name: Apple AI Strategy
stories.blurb: A series of reports examining whether Apple can compete in the consumer AI race, including AI agents, smart home devices, and privacy concerns.

stories.name: MP Materials Apple deal
stories.blurb: MP Materials is ramping up rare earth magnet production and targeting Apple as its next major customer after clearing a GM milestone.

past.name: iPhone 18 launch demand
past.blurb: Apple's iPhone 18 launch is drawing mixed demand signals from analysts, carrier incentives, pricing moves, and a labor strike in Italy.

past.name: Apple Q4 Earnings
past.blurb: Apple reported its fourth-quarter earnings, beating estimates with 12% sales growth, record device install base, and tariff refunds boosting profit.

past.name: Apple news mix
past.blurb: A collection of unrelated headlines that are not actually about Apple or one ongoing story.

past.name: Apple crypto expansion
past.blurb: Apple is increasingly moving into crypto and digital payments, from hiring crypto talent and expanding Apple Pay to its stock being tokenized and traded on crypto platforms.

past.name: Qualcomm Apple patent deal
past.blurb: Qualcomm and Apple renewed their long-term global patent licensing agreement, easing investor fears about Qualcomm's revenue but leaving questions about its growth beyond Apple.

past.name: Apple legal battles
past.blurb: Apple is facing a series of major lawsuits and regulatory probes worldwide, including a record $5.7 billion patent verdict, UK class actions, and investigations in India.

past.name: Meta's Muse AI Surge
past.blurb: Meta's stock rallies as its new AI app Muse gains rapid popularity, boosting investor confidence in the company's AI strategy ahead of Meta Connect.

past.name: Apple vs OpenAI Lawsuit
past.blurb: Apple is suing OpenAI and Jony Ive's io Products, alleging they misappropriated Apple's hardware trade secrets—including via job interviews—for a secret unreleased device, which OpenAI denies.

past.name: Memory Chip Shortage
past.blurb: A global surge in memory and storage chip prices is forcing Apple to raise prices on MacBooks and iPads while even considering banned Chinese chip suppliers to cope with the shortage.

past.name: Apple AI inference push
past.blurb: Apple is positioning its high-end Macs and a planned server chip as a cheaper, unmetered alternative to Nvidia-based cloud AI inference, challenging the token-rental economics of hyperscalers.
